COP.metaTitle: USD to Colombian Peso — Live Exchange Rate (USD/COP)
COP.metaDescription: Live US dollar to Colombian peso exchange rate (USD/COP), updated automatically. 7-day and 30-day trends plus Colombia inflation.
COP.intro: Track the live US dollar to Colombian peso exchange rate (USD/COP). The number below shows how many Colombian pesos one US dollar buys right now, refreshed automatically throughout the day.
COP.about: Colombia's peso floats freely, so USD/COP moves with global markets, oil prices and capital flows. We show the mid-market rate aggregated from public FX data; banks and casas de cambio apply their own spreads, so the rate you get may differ.

ARS.metaTitle: USD to Argentine Peso — Blue Dollar Rate Today (USD/ARS)
ARS.metaDescription: Live Argentine blue dollar rate — the parallel US dollar to Argentine peso exchange rate people actually use. 7-day and 30-day trends plus inflation.
ARS.intro: Track Argentina's 'blue dollar' — the widely used parallel exchange rate for US dollars. The headline number is the average of the blue buy and sell quotes, refreshed throughout the day.
ARS.about: Because of currency controls, the blue-dollar rate reflects what Argentines actually pay on the street and usually differs sharply from the official rate. With high inflation, the peso can lose value quickly, so the rate can move fast.

BRL.metaTitle: USD to Brazilian Real — Live Exchange Rate (USD/BRL)
BRL.metaDescription: Live US dollar to Brazilian real exchange rate (USD/BRL), updated automatically. 7-day and 30-day trends plus Brazil inflation.
BRL.intro: Track the live US dollar to Brazilian real exchange rate (USD/BRL). The number below shows how many reais one US dollar buys right now, refreshed automatically throughout the day.
BRL.about: The real floats freely and reacts to commodity prices, decisions by the Banco Central do Brasil and global risk sentiment. We show the mid-market rate from public FX data; your bank or broker may quote a different price.

BOB.metaTitle: Bolivian Blue Dollar Today — Live Rate from Binance (USDT/BOB)
BOB.metaDescription: Live Bolivian blue dollar rate, sourced from Binance P2P. Current buy and sell (USDT to bolivianos) with recent trend — the rate Bolivians really use.
BOB.intro: Track the Bolivian 'blue dollar' — the parallel US dollar rate in Bolivia, sourced live from Binance P2P (USDT to bolivianos). With dollars scarce at the official rate, this is the rate many Bolivians actually use.
BOB.about: Bolivia's official rate is pegged near 6.96 Bs per dollar, but dollars are hard to get at that price. The parallel ('blue') rate from peer-to-peer USDT trades on Binance reflects real street demand and typically sits well above the official peg. Buy and sell show the best bid and ask on Binance P2P.

about.metaDescription: What LatamFX is and why it exists: fast, clear US dollar exchange rates for Latin America, including parallel and blue-dollar rates.
body: LatamFX is a simple, fast way to check what the US dollar is really worth across Latin America. We focus on the rates people actually use — including parallel or 'blue' rates — and present them as big, clear numbers you can read at a glance.

Our goal is to be the quickest bookmark for dollar rates in Colombia, Argentina, Brazil and Bolivia. Rates refresh automatically from public sources, with the Bolivian blue rate sourced live from Binance P2P. No clutter, no sign-ups — just the number you came for.
